name: CAF Urbos 3 (Budapest 9-module)

energySource.rationale: Not attributed to one source in the import; see notes.

costRecords.item: 47 Urbos 3 trams (mix of 34 m and 56 m units) after the 2014 call-off
costRecords.note: Total for the 47 trams ordered by then; not split by length (secondary source).

notes: Nine-module, about 56 m long Budapest Urbos 3 (Hungarian Wikipedia photo caption: 55.9 m); up to 562 passengers (CAF, no seated/standing split). maxSpeedKmh = 50 is the service speed CAF states for the Budapest trams; a design maximum speed was not found in the sources read. Power 840 kW for the long trams (560 kW for the 34 m five-module trams). First long tram received its operating permit in March 2016 (line 1). Supply voltage, width, weight, doors and module layout (suspended modules) not stated in the sources read.
